Hi Alice / Procurement team,

Hope you had a good weekend. Per our renewal conversation last month, attached is the updated SOW (ACME_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf) that reflects the agreed term extension and the 20% committed capacity increase for Q4. Key points: 
- Term: 24 months, start 2028-09-01
- Committed throughput: +20% GPU hours across dedicated cluster
- Pricing: see Appendix A (annualized unit rates)

Two asks to keep the renewal on the accelerated path:
1) Can Procurement open a PO referencing deal RDW-ACME-2028Q3-0421 in your portal? Our recommended PO description: "Redwood Inference - Dedicated Capacity - Renewal + Capacity Increase".
2) One quick recert: we need the vendor recertification packet filled (SOC2 snapshot + updated W9/contracting contact). I've attached the SOW and can provide SOC2 link if needed.

If you prefer, I can submit the vendor package directly into your procurement portal — please share the upload link or the contact that handles vendor forms. We can also route the DocuSign envelope once legal is done.

Thanks — aiming to complete approvals by 07/10 to hit the desired capacity start date.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Diego —

Thanks for the SOW. A couple of procurement blockers on our side:
1) Vendor recertification: we need the SOC2 Type II attestation (most recent) and the completed vendor form (vendor risk questionnaire). You can upload both to our procurement portal here: https://procure.acmehealth.com/vendor-onboard/submit/98765.
2) PO cadence: Finance needs the exact remit and invoice cadence (annual vs monthly). If you can confirm invoice terms (Net 30 by default) and a primary remit email, that will speed routing.

Also, legal will review price tables — any planned concessions after initial sign will need an approval path.

I'll aim to kick off the portal submission later today if you can provide the SOC2 link and the filled vendor form.

Regards,
